hook: Emad Mostaque founded Stability AI in 2019 and turned it into the company behind Stable Diffusion, the open-weight image model that pushed generative AI into public use in August 2022. A former hedge fund manager, he positioned Stability AI as a counterweight to closed AI labs, backing open releases rather than gating models behind an API. He resigned as CEO and left the board in March 2024, saying he wanted to pursue decentralized AI outside a single company, and by late 2024 Stability AI confirmed he no longer had any control over it.

standing.watch: What is unresolved is the litigation around Stability AI and the question of Mostaque's role after his exit. The Andersen case is active and heading toward the first U.S. AI copyright jury trial, according to a record dated 2026-09-22. The Getty Images case against Stability AI, Inc. is active, with jurisdictional and joinder motions resolved and a trial window in late 2026 to 2027, according to a record dated 2026-06-01. The other three cases, EVOX Productions, Anders, and Getty Images against Stability AI, Ltd., are filed with docket monitoring active and no development recorded yet. Stability AI confirmed in October 2024 that Mostaque no longer controls it, and the records list no new company or role for him after that. His stated intention to pursue decentralized AI outside a single company appears in the profile, but the site records no entity or case tied to that effort.
standing.record: The site's records add up to a founder whose company became a litigation target. Stability AI is listed as a London startup founded in 2019, with Mostaque as founder and former executive. The lawsuits on the site all name Stability AI entities: EVOX Productions LLC v. Stability AI, Inc., Anders v. Stability AI US Services Corporation, Getty Images (US), Inc. v. Stability AI, Ltd., Getty Images (US), Inc. v. Stability AI, Inc., and Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd. Two are active, with Getty Images against Stability AI, Inc. heading toward a trial window in late 2026 to 2027 and Andersen heading toward the first U.S. AI copyright jury trial. Three are filed with docket monitoring active and no development recorded yet. The pattern is that the records connect Mostaque to Stability AI's founding and Stable Diffusion, while the legal activity attaches to the company rather than to him personally.
standing.standing: Emad Mostaque stands in artificial intelligence as the founder of Stability AI and the backer of Stable Diffusion, but the records show he no longer controls the company. He founded Stability AI in 2019 and served as its chief executive officer and a company director from November 2019 until his resignation in March 2024. He resigned as CEO and left the board in March 2024, saying he wanted to pursue decentralized AI outside a single company. By October 2024 Stability AI confirmed he no longer had any control over it. The site lists him as founder and as an executive of Stability AI, but that executive role is historical. His current influence, as the records show, rests on the open-weight model he backed and released in August 2022, not on ongoing control of the company.
